social_circle.name: Linda Wood

demographics.occupation: High school sophomore English teacher (public high school in Bayside, Queens; 22 years at the same school; UFT union member)
demographics.education: Bachelor's degree minimum; New York public-school teachers typically hold a master's (inferred from role, not stated in interview)

background.how_they_met: Met at a mutual friend's wedding in 1994 (Q01).
background.why_close: Married since June 1996 (~30 years). William's first call for emotional support ('I'd call Mike, or talk to Linda, or sit with it' — Q49) and the partner he made his pivotal 2008 career decision with using a literal pros-and-cons spreadsheet at the kitchen table (Q03). She is the warmer of the two of them, the family birthday-rememberer (Q05), and the person who reminded him about school-board elections (Q23) and made him call the doctor after the chest tightness episode (Q33). Their relationship deepened further after the 2025 cardiac scare conversation (Q44).

interests: acupuncture (uses it for migraine prevention, Q37)
couples dinners with the Garcias and Cohens (Q07)
Florida visits to her own mother (Q35)
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Warm, direct, grounding. Tends to deliver pivotal advice in a single sentence ('whichever you choose, I want to be married to the version of you that comes out of it' — Q03 follow-up).

shared_activities: Sunday dinner with the kids every other week (Q05)
Wednesday 7pm spin class at the Y (Q15, Q18)
Friday date nights (resumed after Emily moved out, Q11)
Monthly tech-literacy volunteering at Queens Library Little Neck branch (Q17)
Couples dinners monthly with the Garcias and Cohens (Q07)

Annual Florida trips to her mother (Q35, Q59)
Joint financial management — Linda handles taxes, William handles bills (Q17, Q55)

recent_text_topics: Greek Islands sailing trip planning for 30th anniversary in 2026 (Q62, Q108)
Logistics around William's mother in Hempstead — meal delivery, doorbell cameras, aide discussion with Carol (Q05, Q35)
Spin class scheduling and cholesterol/lifestyle changes (Q15, Q18)
Sunday dinner menu and which kids are coming (Q05)
Otis the dog (vet appointments, brakes for her car last month — Q57)
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q01 ('I met my wife, Linda, at a friend's wedding in '94'), Q03 ('Linda and I sat down at the kitchen table on a Sunday and worked through it together'), Q05, Q07, Q11, Q15 ('Wednesdays we go to a 7pm spin class together at the Y'), Q17 ('I pay the household bills — Linda handles taxes'), Q33 ('Linda made me go'), Q44 ('I talked to Linda about it on a Friday night and that helped'), Q49, Q55, Q66 ('Linda's the union member in the family — UFT'), Q84 ('Married.
